insights.one_liner: Ortec Finance is a Rotterdam maker of investment-modelling software for pension funds and insurers, founded by econometrics students; IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Builds software models for pension funds, insurers and asset managers, covering risk, climate scenarios and financial planning.
Staff are often econometricians, economists and mathematicians from Erasmus, VU, TU Delft, UvA and Leiden.
Has about 405 employees, with offices in Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Melbourne, the UK, Canada, Singapore and Switzerland.

open.text: ORTEC Finance B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Roots go back to ORTEC, founded in 1981 by Erasmus econometrics students; became independent through a 2007 management buyout.
Partnered with Aviva to expand access to financial advice.
Won a mandate from Ostrum AM for its asset-liability management platform.
